description: The system shall allow users to access the portal through personal credential authentication.
The system shall validate user credentials and grant access to portal functionalities upon successful authentication.
The system shall display a list of applications to which the authenticated user has access.
The system shall allow users to access applications from the portal.
The system shall restrict data visualization and actions (create, modify, delete) based on the user's assigned roles.
The system shall ensure that users cannot access data belonging to other clients.
The system shall automatically convert any mention of the old name to the new name throughout the portal and applications.
The system shall allow administrators to assign or revoke application access for users.
The new content must maintain visual coherence with the design of the old version of the application.
Design, colors, fonts, and organization must be consistent with the old version.
The system must be easy to use for any user.
80% of users shall not need to ask for third-party help to use the application.
The application must be available in multiple languages.
The user must be able to perform new operations without special training.
The learning time for new functionalities should not exceed 5 minutes.
Query operations must have a loading time of less than 1 second.
Response time shall not exceed 1 second in 95% of queries.
The web application must guarantee continuous and stable operation, ensuring its availability at all times.
System availability must be at least 99.9%, even during peak usage times.
The web application must support a large number of concurrent users without degrading its performance.
The system must allow the creation, query, modification, and deletion of data for authorized users.
The application must manage a strict separation of data for each client.
Dates must be valid and cannot be later than the present.
Authorizations and Cluster assigned to a user must be of the same Cluster type as the user.
